script.code:
SELECT
  id,
  item_id,
  organization_id,
  plant_id,
  storage_location_id,
  sales_demand_qty,
  actual_consumption_qty,
  summary_date,
  abnormal_flag,
  abnormal_reason,
  exclude_from_dynamic
FROM item_daily_summary
WHERE item_id = '{{node:loop_GvW0LO0l.id}}'
  AND summary_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL ({{node:get_node_lx8BhzFr.data.data.usage_window_days}} - 1) DAY)
ORDER BY summary_date DESC;

SELECT 
  id,
  item_id,
  plant_id,
  create_time AS latest_create_date,
  line_status,
  supplier_id
FROM purchase_order_2ukyuanr_sub
WHERE item_id = '{{node:loop_GvW0LO0l.id}}'
  AND plant_id = '{{node:loop_l6wx6B3F}}'
  AND line_status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Draft')
  AND is_deleted = 0
ORDER BY create_time DESC
LIMIT 1;
